findings.title: Diagnostic-delay conversion failure bypasses mandatory shutdown quiescence
findings.scenario: Set the documented tc_signal._RELEASE_EXIT_DIAG_S to 1 << 4096. A daemon thread is inside a finite producer deleter (read-only output refusal before any launch); at ordinary exit float(knob) raises OverflowError. Only TypeError/ValueError are handled by the fallback, so the outer handler logs and returns without _exit_close_admission. Finalization overtakes the deleter and CPython 3.12 forced unwind aborts through the noexcept/catch-all release frame. Core has the same bypass for _DLPACK_SHUTDOWN_WAIT_S. This does not unregister or replace the shutdown hook.
findings.fix: Make close-and-wait unconditional with respect to diagnostic configuration: validate/clamp the knob before shutdown or handle conversion failures with an already available safe default and still call the raw close function. At minimum cover OverflowError; cover other ordinary conversion exceptions too. Add finite-callback shutdown regressions for both hooks.
findings.evidence: Fresh unchanged full add-on built in /tmp/p1t_rev7_build; logs/p1t_rev7_knob_exit.log: OverflowError: int too large to convert to float; FINALIZING True; FATAL: exception not rethrown; rc134. findings.title: Completion-event query failure is reported as a failed stream synchronization
findings.scenario: The phase1 legacy-stream synchronization succeeds. A one-shot cudaEventQuery in phase2 fails; sync_and_release_all_impl puts its error into the same untyped SyncReport.dev/err arrays as stream errors. synchronize then says the legacy stream could not be synchronized. The failing API is absent and the named sync actually succeeded, misleading diagnosis. The operand is conservatively leaked and the error retained/raised, so this is a diagnostic defect, not a lifetime failure.
findings.fix: Carry an allocation-free failure-kind tag (stream sync vs event query) in SyncReport and preserve it through merge; build the diagnostic from that tag, naming cudaEventQuery and the affected device for query failures. Add a test distinguishing the two sites.
findings.evidence: Actual-source CPU trace; logs/p1t_rev7_query_diagnostic_rc.log: successful sync devices [0], then message says legacy stream of device 0 could not be synchronized; probe exits1. No GPU execution.
findings.prior_art: NVIDIA CUDA12.6 (2024) cudaEventQuery and cudaStreamSynchronize distinct return-code contracts; ordinary site-specific error reporting, no specific prior art known to me. Taken: API attribution; contribution: successful sync followed by one-shot query failure witness.
